chunks: And whatever is in it from Bakr ibn Salih, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from ʿAli ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from his father, from Bakr ibn Salih al-Razi.

key_terms.أَبِي: my father; an immediate link in the chain of transmission
key_terms.بَكْرِ بْنِ صَالِحٍ الرَّازِيِّ: Bakr ibn Salih al-Razi, the narrator to whom this transmission chain leads
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicates the author's act of narration

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Bakr ibn Salih in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Bakr ibn Salih al-Razi. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission in hadith literature and preserving the source pathway for the narration.
